ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity-to-high intensity ratio; estimated <10% high-intensity white pixels against >90% low-intensity black background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black surface across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular blobs (barnacles) localized at the distal tips and scattered in a sparse, non-geometric pattern across the mid-ventral regions. Faint greyish-white mottling observed on the inner right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; central vertex angle estimated at approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the inner lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-mid amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks visible on the upper-left margin and irregular, saw-toothed topography along the right margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral sigmoidal curve; concave curvature proximal to the median notch transitioning to convex curvature toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters. High density at the left and right distal tips; approximately 15-20 smaller, isolated circular white spots distributed across the lower half of the visible fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal linear scratch (high-intensity white) on the upper-right lobe; several faint, near-vertical linear disruptions visible near the center-left trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustations (barnacles) causing physical volumetric protrusion and jagged texture at both distal tips; right tip exhibits a more irregular, potentially eroded profile compared to the left.
other_distinctive_markers: White water turbulence and spray occluding the basal insertion point where the fluke lobes meet the peduncle.
